items.title: Beyond Cosine Similarity: Taming Semantic Drift and Antonym Intrusion in a 15-Million Node Turkish Synonym Graph
items.title_zh: 超越余弦相似度：在 1500 万节点土耳其语同义词图中抑制语义漂移与反义词入侵
items.summary: The system processes 15 million Turkish lexical items and evaluates 520 million candidate relationships to produce 2.9 million high-precision semantic clusters, using a labeled set of 843,000 concept pairs built with Gemini 2.5-Flash and verified against human-curated dictionaries. A three-way relation discriminator reaches 90% macro-F1, and a topology-aware expansion-pruning procedure limits semantic drift and erroneous transitive chains while resolving polysemy.

items.title: Can LLMs Compress (and Decompress)? Evaluating Code Understanding and Execution via Invertibility
items.title_zh: 大语言模型会压缩（与解压）吗？通过可逆性评估代码理解与执行
items.summary: RoundTripCodeEval assesses code understanding through round-trip consistency across four lossless compression algorithms, using execution-free exact-match scoring of bijection fidelity. The authors report that models often pass forward and backward tasks separately yet fail the combined round trip, and that supervised fine-tuning and self-reflection saturate after one revision round without repairing fundamental misunderstandings.

items.title: Prompt Injection Mitigation with Agentic AI, Nested Learning, and AI Sustainability via Semantic Caching
items.title_zh: 结合智能体 AI、嵌套学习与语义缓存的提示注入缓解及 AI 可持续性
items.summary: The paper extends the Total Injection Vulnerability Score with an Observability Score Ratio to study how mitigation strictness trades off with transparency in a nested-learning agentic pipeline. Across 301 synthetic injection prompts, the system reports zero high-risk breaches, while semantic-similarity caching in a continuum memory system cuts LLM calls by 41.6% and reduces latency, energy use, and emissions.

items.title: Improving the Safety and Trustworthiness of Medical AI via Multi-Agent Evaluation Loops
items.title_zh: 通过多智能体评估循环提升医疗 AI 的安全性与可信度
items.summary: The framework pairs generative models DeepSeek R1 and Med-PaLM with evaluation agents LLaMA 3.1 and Phi-4, which score responses against AMA medical-ethics principles and a five-tier safety risk protocol across 900 clinical queries. It reports faster convergence for DeepSeek R1, an 89% reduction in ethical violations, and a 92% risk downgrade rate.

items.title: A Hybrid Protocol for Large-Scale Semantic Dataset Generation in Low-Resource Languages: The Turkish Semantic Relations Corpus
items.title_zh: 低资源语言大规模语义数据集生成的混合协议：土耳其语语义关系语料库
items.summary: The authors describe a three-phase protocol that combines FastText embeddings with agglomerative clustering, Gemini 2.5-Flash classification, and curated dictionaries to build a Turkish semantic-relations corpus. The resulting 843,000 unique pairs across synonyms, antonyms, and co-hyponyms represent a tenfold scale increase at about $65, and downstream embedding and classification models reach 90% top-1 retrieval accuracy and 90% F1-macro.

items.title: Do Instruction-Tuned Models Always Perform Better Than Base Models? Evidence from Math and Domain-Shifted Benchmarks
items.title_zh: 指令微调模型总是表现更好吗？来自数学与域偏移基准的证据
items.summary: The authors compare base and instruction-tuned models on standard math benchmarks, structurally perturbed variants, and domain-shifted tasks. They find the instruction-tuning advantage is unstable: in zero-shot chain-of-thought GSM8K settings base models consistently outperform tuned variants, with drops as high as 32.67% for Llama3-70B, and tuned models show sharp declines under distribution shift and prompt perturbation.

items.title: OI-Bench: An Option Injection Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Susceptibility to Directive Interference
items.title_zh: OI-Bench：评估大语言模型受指令干扰程度的选项注入基准
items.summary: OI-Bench adds a misleading directive as an extra option to multiple-choice questions, creating 3,000 questions across knowledge, reasoning, and commonsense tasks with 16 directive types such as social compliance, bonus framing, threat framing, and instructional interference. Evaluating 12 LLMs reveals substantial and heterogeneous vulnerabilities, and the authors examine inference-time prompting and post-training alignment as mitigations.

items.title: MOSLD-Bench: Multilingual Open-Set Learning and Discovery Benchmark for Text Categorization
items.title_zh: MOSLD-Bench：面向文本分类的多语言开放集学习与发现基准
items.summary: MOSLD-Bench is described as the first multilingual open-set learning and discovery benchmark for topic-based text categorization, with 960K samples across 12 languages. The authors also propose a multi-stage framework for continuously discovering and learning new classes.

items.title: tech-leads-club/agent-skills
items.title_zh: tech-leads-club/agent-skills：面向专业 AI 编程智能体的经验证技能注册表
items.summary: agent-skills is a TypeScript-based registry of validated skills for professional AI coding agents, designed to extend tools including Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot.
